plan: With a private value of $30, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid close to, but not exceeding, my true value. Rational opponents will also bid strategically. I'll aim to bid around $29-$30 to maximize potential profit, considering that paying the second-highest bid means I need some margin below my true value.

In a single-round sealed bid auction with rational opponents, I'll aim to maximize expected profit. My value is $35. A naive approach would be to bid exactly my value, but sophisticated opponents will anticipate this. I'll bid strategically below my value to create a potential profit margin. Since the second-highest bid determines my payment, I'll choose a bid that balances winning probability with profit potential - around $33-$34.

With a private value of $6, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a moderate approach. My goal is to win only if the bid is below my value. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their own value. I'll bid around $5.50 - slightly below my value but competitive. This gives me a chance to win if others bid conservatively, while protecting against overpaying.
